name: Iconik Sports and Events Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1968, Iconik Sports and Events Ltd provides Information Technology and Business Consultancy 
 services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
On November 13th 2024, the company made amendments to the main objects of MoU. The company is engaged in organization, management, promotion, and execution of sports leagues, tournaments, and events across various disciplines, including but not limited to:
a) Padel
b) Tennis
c) Cricket
Additionally, the company seeks to establish, operate, and manage sports academies, fostering Training centres, Coaching facilities, Sports complexes, and other infrastructure for development and training of players at all skill levels in padel, tennis, and other sports.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 204% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.46 times its book value
Company has high debtors of 327 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -61.2%
Working capital days have increased from -41.5 days to 183 days
